name: ovaijisuandesign
title_zh: 自建 MaaS 平台的画布
tagline_zh: 不想把推理请求交给别人的话，这套把画布、网关、MCP 代理都留在你自己机器上；适合先跑通再谈规模。
tagline_en: Keeps canvas, gateway and MCP agent on your own box instead of someone else's API; good for a first working loop.
desc_en: Standalone canvas + gateway + MCP agent for a self-hosted MaaS platform. Personal research project.
why_zh: 三块拼成一个闭环：画布画流程、网关转发模型、MCP 代理接工具，中间没有第三方托管层。
why_en: Three pieces close one loop: canvas for flows, gateway for model routing, MCP agent for tools, with no third-party hosting layer.
limit_zh: 个人研究项目，没有多租户、计费和权限体系；只覆盖画布+网关+MCP 这一格，模型权重和 GPU 得你自己备。
limit_en: Personal research project: no multi-tenancy, billing or permissions. Covers only canvas + gateway + MCP; you supply weights and GPUs.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Canvas, gateway and MCP agent for a self-hosted MaaS stack
